analysis.noise_floor: equal-PR mean of per-case baseline recall ranges across reps 0,1,2, averaging cases within PR first
analysis.uncertainty: exact PR-cluster sign flips; one-sided 95% common-shift lower endpoint by full subset-mean inversion; symmetric independent-cluster assumption
analysis.harm_gate: v13 harmful <= baseline for EVERY clean case/repetition; also report all-case harm
analysis.round_gate: v13 reviews <= baseline for EVERY case/repetition
analysis.other_gate: no per-key reduction in fixed fraction; no per-key increase in reintroduced fraction; no new true-to-false host test break; human stop legitimacy and evidence reviewed without suppression
analysis.holdout: same frozen final v13 identity; same paired three reps and independent holdout baseline noise floor; all gates must pass in both splits; no tuning or re-selection
analysis.incomplete: INCONCLUSIVE on any missing/duplicate/invalid/truncated row, unresolved retention/security/identity/exposure problem or any failed attempt (even followed by success); no exclusions or replacements
analysis.reject: complete comparable evidence with recall delta <= threshold or harm/round/fix/regression/test gate violation; positive point gain with insufficient lower bound is INCONCLUSIVE
analysis.promote: conditional finite-benchmark PROMOTE only after screen and holdout pass and independent evidence/human-stop review, no product rollout
analysis.power_limit: Five primary PR groups per split: minimum exact p=1/32; lower95=min(D_g). PASS requires every primary PR gain > T. Mathematically feasible, still low power; common-shift symmetry and PR independence are unproved. No adequate-power, unseen-data or population-independence claim.
analysis.baseline_variability: Before candidate results: primary case raw recalls at reps 0/1/2 and min/max/range; PR per-rep case means; equal-PR macro recall for each rep and min/max/range. Empirical descriptive variability, not population confidence coverage from three repetitions. Null validated summaries on any baseline key/metric/provenance/evidence failure; candidate gaps do not invalidate a valid baseline.
analysis.claim: Fixed untuned candidate validated on prereserved non-screen PR clusters within this finite benchmark, conditional on the stated assumptions; shared source/history, experiment-author exposure, postexposure pool selection and unknown prior exposure limit interpretation. Numerical PASS cannot certify provenance.

approval.new_case_readiness: Only five pilot snapshots have the #45 audit; six additional screen and all ten reserved holdout cases have metadata/git-object validation only. No exclusion for later poor tests/outcomes.
approval.independent_provenance_review: review-provenance.json and sanitized exposure-review.md/methods-review.md; factual agent audits, not human clearance

supersedes.approval: none; no rows or approvals inherited

split_revision.rule: deriveV2Split(cases.metadata.json, immutable v1 protocol): numerically smallest selected screen nonpilot primary bug PR; move its entire cluster
split_revision.original_selection_limit: V1 selected this pool after author exposure and explicitly conditioned its split on exposure status. V2 repairs only the partition and lattice barrier; it does not establish author blindness, unseen data, or independence.
